## Status

Maturity is a declared field. The user drives promotion. It is not inferred from git or CI.

<div class="entity-table">
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>Value</th><th>Kind</th><th>Meaning</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>idea</code></td><td data-label="Kind">live</td><td data-label="Meaning">Named. Not yet explored.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>exploring</code></td><td data-label="Kind">live</td><td data-label="Meaning">Open questions are real and unresolved.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>defined</code></td><td data-label="Kind">live</td><td data-label="Meaning">Approach is clear. Structured content is required.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>ready</code></td><td data-label="Kind">live</td><td data-label="Meaning">Ready for spec generation.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>delivered</code></td><td data-label="Kind">terminal</td><td data-label="Meaning">The work shipped.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>replaced</code></td><td data-label="Kind">terminal</td><td data-label="Meaning">A named successor took over. Requires replaced-by.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>canceled</code></td><td data-label="Kind">terminal</td><td data-label="Meaning">Abandoned. A reason is optional.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>deprecated</code></td><td data-label="Kind">terminal</td><td data-label="Meaning">Retired without a single named successor.</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>

<div class="entity-illegal">
<p>Illegal</p>
<ul>
<li>Any other status name</li>
<li><code>replaced</code> without <code>replaced-by</code></li>
<li>Self-promoting a bundle to defined or ready</li>
<li>An issue inside a bundle track</li>
</ul>
</div>

## Constraints

- Feature work uses bundle → spec → plan
- One bundle. Many specs. One plan per spec.
- Bundles start at exploring with real open questions
- Do not hand-write a bundle into existence

## Validate

<pre><code>backstop artifact validate --bundle BUNDLE-NNN</code></pre>

## Reviewer

`bundle-reviewer`. Independent of the bundle author. A bundle has no upstream artifact, so review checks internal coherence and documented invariants.

- Reads the bundle on its merits
- Checks open questions, requirements, and spec seeds
- Findings go back to the bundle author
- Specing does not start on a bundle that failed review

## Notes

A bundle is substantial work. It decomposes into specs. Each spec has exactly one plan.

Product code is not written from the bundle. The implementer executes an approved plan.
